title: 第十五章实战训练第十六章登云酒楼
content_zh:
;;
平州临海城，坐落于科拉河入海口，背倚群山余脉，面朝东海万顷碧波。
飞舰破开云层，缓缓驶入临海城上空时，正是七月雨季。连日暴雨使得科拉河河水暴涨，浑浊而奔腾的洪流自西向东，像一条被激怒的黄色巨龙，咆哮着冲入东海。而东南季风正盛，卷着海水自南向北倒灌，在河口处与河水猛烈相撞，激起漫天水雾与如山般的浪头。
秦翊、秦枫与一众女修立于飞舰甲板，凭栏俯瞰。只见下方的临海城在水天之间缩成一方狭长的影子，城墙高耸，却仍被四周翻滚的水势衬得岌岌可危，仿佛一座在怒海中颠簸的孤舟，随时可能被巨浪吞没。
“好壮阔的水势。”秦翊低声道，目光落在河口处那一片混沌的巨浪上，隐隐能感受到其中蕴含的狂暴力量。
秦枫看着城墙下隐约可见的防波堤与法阵光芒，笑道：“能在这种地方建城，临海城的阵法倒是有些门道。”
飞舰缓缓降低高度，城主府前的广场已被清理出来。广场四周由府兵层层封锁，最外层是手持长矛、铠甲鲜明的普通士兵，肃立如松；内层则是气息沉稳的筑基修士，目光锐利地扫视着四周，随时戒备。
城主刘仁轨，一位面容方正、气度沉稳的中年修士，正带领着五位城中主要官员，以及平州仙坛坛主丁原、平州碧云商会会主尤亦文，在广场中央等候。见到飞舰降落，刘仁轨眼中闪过一丝敬畏，率先拱手，身后众人齐齐跟随。
舱门打开，紫徽老祖在前，秦翊、秦枫及秦军主等紧随其后，一行人有序走下飞舰。左右军修士迅速散开，在广场四周布下简易的防护阵势，警惕地注视着四周。
“拜见老祖！”刘城主、五位城中官员以及坛主丁原、会主尤亦文齐声躬身行礼，声音整齐划一，在空旷的广场上回荡。
紫徽老祖脸上带着温和的笑意，抬手虚扶：“刘城主，丁坛主，尤会主，不必多礼。”目光扫过众人，最后落在刘仁轨身上，“多年不见，刘城主风采依旧啊。”
刘仁轨连忙道：“托老祖洪福，临海城尚算安稳。老祖一路辛苦，府中已备下薄酒，还请老祖移步内府一叙。”
“好，好。”紫徽老祖笑了笑，意有所指地说道，“老夫可是惦记着刘城主那坛海珍酿呢，多年未曾尝过，不知今日是否有此口福？”
刘仁轨心中一松，连忙道：“早已为老祖备下，只等老祖驾临。”
尤亦文也适时笑道：“老祖驾临临海城，是我等的荣幸。碧云商会也备了些好酒，稍后还请老祖品鉴。”
紫徽老祖微微颔首，不再多言，在刘仁轨的引领下，一行人朝城主府内走去。穿过高大的府门，迎面是一座宽敞的门厅，两侧立着姿态威猛的石狮。越过门厅，便是一片精致的庭院，假山流水，花木扶疏。绕过院中“聚贤楼”的三层楼阁，前方出现一道月洞门，门上题着“水榭”二字。推门而入，眼前豁然开朗。只见一汪清澈的池水映入眼帘，水面如镜，倒映着蓝天白云与岸边垂柳，正是府中有名的“砚池”。砚池不大，却布置得极为精巧，池边点缀着几块奇形怪状的山石，几株睡莲静静漂浮在水面，花瓣洁白如玉。
沿着池边的曲折回廊前行，经过一座小巧玲珑的“临水亭”，亭下有石桥通往池心。再往前，便是一片连绵的竹林，竹叶青翠欲滴，在微风中沙沙作响，与远处的水波声交织在一起，仿佛一首天然的乐曲，这一带被称为“翠幄连波”。
众人绕至砚池北岸，一座二层楼的阁楼出现在眼前，匾额上书写着三个苍劲有力的大字——“观澜堂”。这里便是城主府中宴请贵客的地方。
观澜堂内，早已由府中佣人布置妥当。厅堂两侧摆放着数十张条形桌椅。桌上已摆满了各种灵果、灵肉以及精致的菜肴，空气中弥漫着诱人的香气。
紫徽老祖在主位落座，刘仁轨及城中几位主要官员坐在右侧，秦翊、秦枫兄弟与秦军主、丁坛主、尤会主等则坐在左侧。众人依次落座后，一队队身着彩衣的凡俗美女鱼贯而入，她们手中端着酒壶，壶内盛装着那坛被众人期待的海珍酿。这些女子皆是容貌秀丽，身段婀娜，一举一动都带着经过精心训练的柔美。她们将手中的酒壶放在桌上，然后分立在众人座位两侧，随时准备为众人添酒。

“来，诸位，先满上这杯海珍酿！”刘仁轨站起身，亲自上前为紫徽老祖斟满一杯，又依次为秦军主、秦翊、秦枫等人添酒，脸上洋溢着热情的笑容。
众人纷纷举杯，齐声说道：“敬老祖！”
紫徽老祖微微一笑，举杯示意，随后一饮而尽。秦翊、秦枫等人也将杯中酒一饮而下。
这海珍酿果然名不虚传。酒液入口，先是一股醇厚的酒香在口腔中炸开，随即化作一股暖流，顺着喉咙缓缓流入腹中。在这股暖流流经之处，仿佛有无数细小的气泡在轻轻炸裂，释放出各种奇异的鲜味，既有深海灵鱼的清甜，又有海底奇贝的鲜香，还有一些难以言喻的复杂滋味，在舌尖与喉间交织缠绕，让人回味无穷。
“好！好！好！”紫徽老祖连说三个好字，眼中闪过一丝满意的光芒，“多年未饮，这海珍酿的滋味，倒是一点也没变。刘城主，你这酿酒的手艺，可是越发精进了。”
刘仁轨脸上露出一丝得意之色，连忙谦逊道：“老祖谬赞了，能入老祖法眼，是这酒的福气。”
接下来，便是觥筹交错，宾主尽欢。众人一边品尝着桌上产自东海的灵果灵肉，一边畅饮着海珍酿，谈论着修仙界的奇闻轶事，以及临海城近年来的发展。秦翊与秦枫兄弟俩一边听着，一边不时观察着在座众人的神色，默默记下有用的信息。
这场宴会一直持续到深夜，观澜堂内的灯火渐渐黯淡，众人也都有了几分醉意。在刘仁轨等人的恭送下，紫徽老祖带着秦翊、秦枫及一众随行修士，离开了城主府，返回了平州仙坛。
平州仙坛，是平州负责修仙所有事宜的重地，也是碧霄仙宗高层在平州的居所。仙坛建在城中高地之上，四周灵气浓郁。回到仙坛后，随行的修士们各自散去休息，秦翊与秦枫也回到了自己的住处。
待一切都安静下来，整座仙坛仿佛陷入了沉睡。就在这时，三道几乎与夜色融为一体的黑影，悄无声息地从仙坛深处飞出，如同三只离弦的箭，朝着城外那片茫茫大海疾驰而去。
这三道黑影的速度极快，眨眼间便已越过临海城的城墙，消失在远方的水天相接之处。
……
一天后，在一片无边无际的大海上空，三道身影悄然停下。
这里已是远离陆地的深海区域，一座孤岛，四周除了一望无际的海水，便只剩下偶尔掠过的海鸟，以及从海底传来的低沉咆哮声。三道身影停下后，周身的气息微微波动，随即显露出了真容，正是紫徽老祖，以及秦翊、秦枫兄弟俩。紫徽老祖先是放出神识，仔细探查了一番四周的情况，确认没有其他强大的气息存在后，才缓缓收回神识，说道：“走。”话音刚落，他率先朝着下方的海面俯冲而去。秦翊与秦枫对视一眼，也连忙跟了上去。
三人的身形如同三颗流星，划破天空，落在了荒岛的沙滩上。这座小岛不大，岛上覆盖着茂密的丛林，沙滩上布满了贝壳和被海浪冲上来的枯枝。空气中弥漫着一股淡淡的咸腥味，以及丛林中特有的潮湿气息。
在紫徽老祖的带领下，三人穿过沙滩，进入了丛林。丛林中光线昏暗，藤蔓缠绕，不时有不知名的毒虫从树干上爬过，发出窸窸窣窣的声响。秦翊与秦枫兄弟俩不敢大意，各自运转灵力，护住周身，警惕地观察着四周。
穿过丛林，三人来到了小岛中央。这里有一块巨大的礁石，礁石表面光滑，仿佛经过了岁月的打磨。礁石上刻着一些模糊的纹路，隐隐透着一丝古老而神秘的气息。
紫徽老祖站在礁石前，仔细观察了片刻，随后双手快速结印。随着他手中法诀的变化，礁石上那些模糊的纹路渐渐亮起，散发出淡淡的光芒。片刻之后，一道耀眼的传送光芒从礁石上冲天而起，将三人的身影完全笼罩。光芒闪烁间，三人的身影如同被空间吞噬一般，瞬间消失在了原地。
在他们消失后，原本空无一物的礁石裂缝中，突然多出了几只通体赤红的蚂蚁。这些红蚁体型不大，却散发着一丝微弱的灵力波动，它们在裂缝中爬来爬去，似乎在守护着什么。
……

与此同时，在数万里之外的另一座小岛上，天空中突然闪过一道耀眼的光芒。光芒散去，三道身影凭空出现在了小岛的上空。
这座小岛与之前那座荒岛截然不同。这里的植被更加茂密，灵气也更加浓郁，四周的海面上，不时有巨大的海兽身影从水中掠过，激起一阵阵浪花。
紫徽老祖睁开双眼，灵目闪动，两道实质般的光芒从他眼中射出，瞬间笼罩了整座小岛及其四周的海域。在他的脑海中，清晰地浮现出了这座岛屿四周的景象，包括附近海域中潜藏的各种海妖的大致位置和实力。过了片刻，紫徽老祖才缓缓收回目光，脸上露出一丝满意的笑容。“不错，这里的环境，很适合你们历练。”紫徽老祖转头看向秦翊和秦枫，说道，“从今天起，我们就暂时在这里落脚。一边寻找几种罕见的灵材，一边让你们兄弟俩与这里的海妖战斗，提升实战经验。记住，在生死边缘徘徊，是提升修为最快的捷径。”
秦翊与秦枫兄弟俩齐声应道：“是，老祖！”

Pingzhou Linhai City is located at the mouth of the Kola River, backed by the mountains and facing the vast expanse of blue waves of the East China Sea.
When the airship broke through the clouds and slowly sailed into the sky above Linhai City, it was the rainy season in July. Days of heavy rain have caused the Kola River to swell. The turbid and rushing torrent flows from west to east, roaring into the East China Sea like an enraged yellow dragon. The southeast monsoon is in full swing, bringing seawater back from south to north. It collides violently with the river water at the mouth of the river, causing water mist and mountain-like waves.
Qin Yi, Qin Feng and a group of female cultivators stood on the deck of the airship, leaning on the railing to overlook. I could see the Linhai City below shrunk into a long and narrow shadow between the water and the sky. The city wall was towering, but it was still precarious by the rolling water around it. It was like a lonely boat bumping in the angry sea, which could be swallowed by the huge waves at any time.
"What a magnificent water force." Qin Yi whispered, his eyes falling on the chaotic waves at the mouth of the river, and he could faintly feel the violent power contained in it.
Qin Feng looked at the faintly visible breakwaters and formations under the city wall, and said with a smile: "To be able to build a city in a place like this, Linhai City's formations have some skills."
The airship slowly lowered its altitude, and the square in front of the city lord's mansion had been cleared. The square is surrounded by layers of government soldiers. On the outermost layer are ordinary soldiers holding spears and wearing bright armor, standing as solemn as pine trees. On the inner layer are calm foundation-building monks, scanning the surroundings with sharp eyes, always on guard.
City Lord Liu Rengui, a middle-aged monk with a square face and calm demeanor, is waiting in the center of the square with five main officials in the city, as well as Ding Yuan, the leader of the Pingzhou Immortal Altar, and You Yiwen, the leader of the Pingzhou Biyun Chamber of Commerce. Seeing the airship landing, Liu Rengui's eyes flashed with awe, and he took the lead in handing over, followed by everyone behind him.
The hatch opened, with Ancestor Zi Hui in front, followed closely by Qin Yi, Qin Feng, and Commander Qin, and the group stepped off the spacecraft in an orderly manner. The monks from the left and right armies quickly dispersed and set up simple protective formations around the square, watching the surroundings with vigilance.
"Greetings to the ancestor!" City Lord Liu, five city officials, altar leader Ding Yuan, and meeting leader You Yiwen bowed in unison, and their voices were uniform and echoed in the empty square.
Ancestor Zi Hui had a gentle smile on his face and raised his hand to support him: "City Master Liu, Master Ding Tan, Master You Hui, there is no need to be polite." His eyes swept across the crowd, and finally fell on Liu Rengui, "I haven't seen you for many years, City Master Liu's style is still the same."
Liu Rengui hurriedly said: "Thanks to our ancestor Hongfu, Linhai City is still relatively stable. Our ancestor has worked hard all the way, and we have prepared a small amount of wine in the mansion. Please come to the inner palace to talk about it."
"Okay, okay." Ancestor Zihui smiled and said pointedly, "I am thinking about Lord Liu's Tanhai wine. I haven't tasted it for many years. I wonder if I will have such a good taste today?"
Liu Rengui felt relieved and said quickly: "We have already prepared it for our ancestors. We are just waiting for our ancestors to arrive."
You Yiwen also smiled at the right time and said: "It is an honor for us, ancestor, to come to Linhai City. The Biyun Chamber of Commerce has also prepared some good wine, and I will invite ancestor to taste it later."
The ancestor of Zihui nodded slightly and said no more. Under the guidance of Liu Rengui, the group walked towards the city lord's palace. Passing through the tall gate, you are faced with a spacious foyer with majestic stone lions standing on both sides. Beyond the foyer, there is an exquisite courtyard with rockeries, flowing water, and scattered flowers and trees. After bypassing the three-story pavilion of the "Juxian Building" in the courtyard, a moon cave door appeared in front, with the word "Water Pavilion" inscribed on the door. Pushing the door open, your eyes suddenly open up. Only a clear pool of water came into view. The water surface was like a mirror, reflecting the blue sky, white clouds and weeping willows on the shore. It was the famous "Inkstone Pool" in the mansion. The inkstone pool is not big, but it is arranged very delicately. The edge of the pool is dotted with several strange-shaped rocks, and several water lilies float quietly on the water, with petals as white as jade.
Walking along the winding corridor beside the pool, you pass a small and exquisite "waterfront pavilion" with a stone bridge under the pavilion leading to the center of the pool. Further forward, there is a continuous bambooIn the forest, the bamboo leaves are green and rustling in the breeze, intertwined with the sound of distant water waves, like a natural music, this area is called "Green Waves".
Everyone walked around to the north bank of the inkstone, and a two-story attic appeared in front of them. On the plaque were written three powerful characters - "Guanlan Hall". This is the place where the city lord entertains distinguished guests.
The Guanlan Hall has already been decorated by the servants of the mansion. Dozens of strip tables and chairs are placed on both sides of the hall. The table is filled with various spiritual fruits, spiritual meats and exquisite dishes, and the air is filled with tempting aroma.
The ancestor of Zihui sat down in the main seat, Liu Rengui and several important officials in the city sat on the right, and brothers Qin Yi and Qin Feng, Qin Junzhu, Ding Tanzhu, You Huizhu, etc. sat on the left. After everyone took their seats, groups of ordinary beauties in colorful clothes filed in. In their hands were wine pots, which contained the jar of sea wine that everyone was looking forward to. These women are all beautiful in appearance, graceful in figure, and every move carries a carefully trained softness. They put the wine bottles in their hands on the table, and then stood on both sides of everyone's seats, ready to add wine to everyone at any time.
"Come on, everyone, fill up this cup of sea wine first!" Liu Rengui stood up and personally stepped forward to fill a cup for the ancestor Zi Hui. He then refilled the cup for the Qin Army Leader, Qin Yi, Qin Feng and others in turn, with a warm smile on his face.
Everyone raised their glasses and said in unison: "Respect the ancestors!"
Ancestor Zi Hui smiled slightly, raised his glass, and then drank it all in one gulp. Qin Yi, Qin Feng and others also drank the wine in their glasses.
This sea wine truly deserves its reputation. When the wine enters the mouth, a mellow wine aroma first explodes in the mouth, and then turns into a warm current, slowly flowing down the throat into the abdomen. Wherever this warm current flows, it seems as if countless tiny bubbles are bursting gently, releasing a variety of strange and delicious flavors, including the sweetness of deep-sea spirit fish, the fresh fragrance of underwater strange shells, and some indescribable complex flavors that intertwine between the tip of the tongue and the throat, leaving people with endless aftertaste.
"Good! Good! Good!" Ancestor Zi Hui said three good words in a row, with a glint of satisfaction flashing in his eyes, "I haven't drunk it for many years, but the taste of this sea wine has not changed at all. City Lord Liu, your wine-making skills have become more and more sophisticated."
Liu Rengui showed a trace of pride on his face, and he quickly said humbly: "The ancestor is so complimentary. It is a blessing for this wine to be able to gain the respect of the ancestor."
Next, there was a feast of wine and wine, and the host and guest had a great time. While everyone was tasting the spiritual fruits and meat from the East China Sea on the table and drinking the sea wine, they talked about anecdotes about the world of immortality and the development of Linhai City in recent years. Brothers Qin Yi and Qin Feng listened, observing the expressions of everyone present from time to time, and silently jotting down useful information.
The banquet lasted until late at night, the lights in Guanlan Hall gradually dimmed, and everyone was a little drunk. Under the courtesy of Liu Rengui and others, the ancestor of Zihui left the city lord's palace and returned to the Pingzhou Immortal Altar with Qin Yi, Qin Feng and a group of accompanying monks.
Pingzhou Immortal Altar is the important place in Pingzhou responsible for all matters related to immortality. It is also the residence of the senior officials of Bixiao Immortal Sect in Pingzhou. The Immortal Altar is built on a high ground in the city, surrounded by rich aura. After returning to the Immortal Altar, the accompanying monks dispersed to rest, and Qin Yi and Qin Feng also returned to their residences.
When everything quieted down, the entire fairy altar seemed to have fallen into a deep sleep. At this moment, three black shadows, almost blending into the night, flew out from the depths of the fairy altar silently, like three arrows off the string, speeding towards the vast sea outside the city.
These three black shadows moved extremely fast. In the blink of an eye, they had crossed the wall of Linhai City and disappeared into the distance where the water and the sky met.
…
One day later, over the boundless sea, three figures quietly stopped.
This is a deep sea area far away from the land. It is an isolated island surrounded by endless sea water.Seabirds occasionally fly by below, as well as low roars coming from the bottom of the sea. After the three figures stopped, the aura around them fluctuated slightly, and then their true appearance was revealed. It was the ancestor Zi Hui, and the two brothers Qin Yi and Qin Feng. Old Ancestor Zi Hui released his spiritual consciousness, carefully explored the surrounding situation, and after confirming that no other powerful aura existed, he slowly withdrew his spiritual consciousness and said, "Let's go." As soon as he finished speaking, he took the lead and dived towards the sea below. Qin Yi and Qin Feng looked at each other and quickly followed.
The shapes of the three people were like three shooting stars, piercing the sky and landing on the beach of the desert island. The island is not big, covered with dense jungle, and the beach is covered with shells and dead branches washed up by the waves. There is a faint salty smell in the air, as well as the unique moist smell of the jungle.
Under the leadership of Ancestor Zi Hui, the three of them crossed the beach and entered the jungle. The light in the jungle is dim and the vines are entangled. From time to time, unknown poisonous insects crawl across the tree trunks, making rustling sounds. Brothers Qin Yi and Qin Feng did not dare to be careless. They each used their spiritual power to protect their bodies and observed their surroundings vigilantly.
After passing through the jungle, the three of them arrived at the center of the island. There is a huge reef here. The surface of the reef is smooth, as if it has been polished over the years. There are some vague lines carved on the rocks, giving off a faint ancient and mysterious atmosphere.
Ancestor Zi Hui stood in front of the reef, observed it carefully for a moment, and then quickly formed seals with his hands. As the techniques in his hands changed, the vague lines on the rocks gradually lit up, emitting a faint light. A moment later, a dazzling teleportation light rose into the sky from the reef, completely covering the three figures. As the light flickered, the figures of the three people disappeared in an instant as if they were swallowed by space.
After they disappeared, a few red ants suddenly appeared in the cracks in the previously empty reef. These red ants are not big in size, but they exude a faint spiritual energy fluctuation. They crawl around in the cracks, as if they are guarding something.
…
At the same time, on another small island tens of thousands of miles away, a dazzling light suddenly flashed in the sky. The light dissipated, and three figures appeared out of thin air over the island.
This island is completely different from the previous desert island. The vegetation here is denser and the spiritual energy is richer. On the surrounding sea, from time to time, huge sea beast figures pass through the water, causing waves of waves.
Ancestor Zi Hui opened his eyes, his spiritual eyes flashed, and two substantial rays of light shot out from his eyes, instantly covering the entire island and the surrounding sea. In his mind, the scene around the island clearly emerged, including the approximate location and strength of the various sea monsters lurking in the nearby waters. After a while, Ancestor Zi Hui slowly withdrew his gaze, with a satisfied smile on his face. "Yes, the environment here is very suitable for you to practice." Ancestor Zi Hui turned to Qin Yi and Qin Feng and said, "From today on, we will temporarily settle here. While looking for some rare spiritual materials, you two brothers will fight with the sea monsters here to improve your actual combat experience. Remember, wandering on the edge of life and death is the fastest way to improve your cultivation."
Brothers Qin Yi and Qin Feng responded in unison: "Yes, ancestor!"
